title: A wood needs time to recover
titleZh: 清理之后，树林还需要时间
summaryZh: 肯特郡一片树林的垃圾已清走，但生态恢复并没有随清理一起完成。

sentences.text: Hoad’s Wood is an old woodland in Kent, in the south-east of England.
sentences.zh: Hoad’s Wood是英格兰东南部肯特郡的一片古老树林。

sentences.text: It is a special place for rare plants and animals, and local people care about it.
sentences.zh: 这里是珍稀动植物的重要生境，当地居民也很珍视它。

sentences.text: However, criminals brought a large amount of waste there and damaged the place.
sentences.zh: 然而，犯罪分子把大量垃圾运到这里，破坏了这个地方。

sentences.text: In some parts, the piles of rubbish were as high as fifteen feet.
sentences.zh: 有些地方的垃圾堆高达十五英尺。

sentences.text: Officers stopped the illegal operation, and a large team began to remove the waste.
sentences.zh: 执法人员叫停了这项非法活动，一支大型队伍开始清运垃圾。

sentences.text: On 9 October 2026, the Environment Agency announced that the waste had all been cleared.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月9日，英国环境署宣布垃圾已经全部清走。

sentences.text: The team removed 39,500 tonnes of commercial waste from the wood.
sentences.zh: 这支队伍从树林中清运了39,500吨商业活动产生的垃圾。

sentences.text: More than fifty specialist workers took part in the clean-up.
sentences.zh: 五十多名专业人员参与了清理。

sentences.text: Now the next job is to help the land recover.
sentences.zh: 现在，下一项工作是帮助这片土地恢复。

sentences.text: Access to the site will be limited so that nature has time and space to heal.
sentences.zh: 进入这片区域将受到限制，以便自然环境有时间和空间恢复。

sentences.text: So a clean site does not mean that visitors can immediately use every part of it again.
sentences.zh: 因此，垃圾清干净并不意味着游客能立刻重新进入这里的每个区域。

sentences.text: The investigation into the dumping is also continuing.
sentences.zh: 对非法倾倒垃圾的调查也仍在继续。

words.note: rare修饰plants，说明数量少、较难见到，而不是普通或人造。
to后用动词原形remove，表示把垃圾移走。
removed是过去式，说明已经从树林清走的垃圾。
specialist在此修饰workers，指具有专门技能的人员。
will be limited是将来时被动，意思是出入受限，不是扩大或取消限制。

phrases.note: take part in后接活动，took为过去式。
引导目的：限制出入是为了让自然恢复。

sentences.note: does not mean that用于纠正推断：垃圾清走，不等于立即全面开放。

questions.text: Why might a place stay closed after a clean-up?
questions.zh: 一个地方清理之后为什么可能仍然关闭？

expressions.note: 可复用教学表达，不是原文引语。
